local_articles.snippet: The withdrawal of services by some criminal defence solicitors over a new payment model for the District Courts is “not justified”, Taoiseach Micheál Martin has said. Martin was speaking on Wednesday as many criminal defence solicitors in Dublin and across the country took part in a near total withdrawal of services, set to continue on Thursday and over three days next week.
